messages.content: 誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content:
以下列出的是在爵士樂界被廣泛認為是「最佳」或「最具影響力」的歌手（按歷史與現代分別列出）。雖然「最好」是一個主觀概念，但這些名字在音樂史、評論家評價、專輯銷量以及對後世的影響上都具有極高的共識。

| 時期 | 歌手 | 代表作品 / 特色 | 為何被視為頂尖 |
|------|------|-----------------|---------------|
| **經典時期** | **Ella Fitzgerald** | “Summertime”, “Dream a Little Dream of Me” | 無可比擬的音色、即興技巧與完美的節奏感。 |
| | **Billie Holiday** | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” | 深情、富有社會意識的演繹，對爵士歌詞詮釋的標杆。 |
| | **Louis Armstrong** | “What a Wonderful World”, “Stardust” | 雖以小號聞名，但他的歌唱風格開創了爵士流行化。 |
| | **Sarah Sullivan** | “Misty”, “I’ll Be Seeing You” | 以其柔和、抒情的聲線成為爵士女高音的典範。 |
| | **Nat King Cole** | “Unforgettable”, “Mona Lisa” | 以溫暖的低音和流暢的節奏感，將爵士帶入主流。 |
| | **Chet Baker** | “My Funny Valentine”, “Almost Blue” | 小號與歌唱兼備，擁有獨特的憂鬱風格。 |
| | **Frank Sinatra** | “Fly Me to the Moon”, “New York, New York” | 以其標誌性的嗓音和舞台魅力，將爵士與流行結合。 |
| **現代/當代** | **Diana Krall** | “The Look of Love”, “All of Me” | 以鋼琴伴奏和低沉嗓音，將爵士帶入現代流行。 |
| | **Tony Bennett** | “The Way You Look Tonight”, “I’ve Got You Under My Skin” | 以其長壽的職業生涯和對經典曲目的再詮釋而著稱。 |
| | **Esperanza Spalding** | “I Know You Know”, “I Am the One” | 她的即興、創新編曲和跨界合作使她成為新一代的領袖。 |
| | **Gregory Porter** | “Liquid Spirit”, “Love Is Here to Stay” | 以其深情的低音和靈魂般的即興，重新定義了爵士歌唱。 |
| | **Norah Jones** | “Don't Know Why”, “Come Away With Me” | 以其柔和的嗓音和多元化的曲風，將爵士帶入大眾市場。 |

> **備註**  
> - 以上列表並非絕對排名，而是根據歷史地位、評論家評價、專輯銷量、音樂影響力等多重指標綜合考量。  
> - 若你想了解某個特定年代或風格（如硬波普、自由爵士）的歌手，請告訴我，我可以提供更具體的推薦。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which translates to "Who is the best singer in jazz?" They want a list of top singers. We can use the function search_music_instrument_players? But that function searches for top music instrument players, not singers. There's no function for singers. So we need to answer manually. Provide a list of top jazz singers. We can mention historically recognized greats: Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Louis Armstrong (though he's trumpeter and singer), Sarah Vaughan, Nat King Cole, Chet Baker (trumpeter and singer), Frank Sinatra (pop but also jazz). Also modern: Diana Krall, Tony Bennett, Esperanza Spalding, Gregory Porter. Provide a list of top 10. Provide explanation.
